note: Editorial taxonomy. Subregion assignment is a publishing choice, not a geographic fact. 'also' lists a country's secondary placement without repeating it in the menu.

regions.name: North America
regions.lede: Trade and tariff policy, alliance commitments, border and immigration policy, and the fiscal and monetary divergence across Canada, the United States and Mexico.

sections.name: Canada, United States & Mexico
sections.scope: USMCA compliance, tariff and trade-policy actions, and the monetary and fiscal divergence between the three.

regions.name: Europe
regions.lede: Energy security, the sanctions architecture, fiscal fragmentation, and monetary policy divergence between the euro area and the periphery. Coverage is currently narrowed to the four largest euro-area economies plus the United Kingdom, at the editor's direction; the remaining European states are not yet covered and are deliberately absent rather than stubbed.

sections.name: Western Europe
sections.scope: Euro-area fiscal and monetary policy, energy security, and the sanctions architecture. This is a partial list, not the full subregion: the other European states are not currently in scope.

also: European coverage is a four-country subset for now. The subregions that previously existed here -- Northern Europe, Southern Europe, Eastern Europe, the Balkans, the Baltics and Central Europe -- are retired and redirect to /geopolitics/europe/.

regions.name: Middle East & North Africa
regions.lede: Conflict spillovers, energy chokepoints, sanctions regimes, and water and labour migration. Kept as distinct subregions because a single flat list hides the Gulf/Levant distinction that drives the pricing.

sections.name: Gulf
sections.scope: Oil production policy, OPEC+ compliance, and regional capital flows.

sections.name: Levant
sections.scope: Refugee and aid flows, reconstruction financing, and border economics.

sections.name: North Africa
sections.scope: Sovereign debt, energy subsidies, and Mediterranean supply routes.

sections.name: Eastern Mediterranean
sections.scope: Maritime boundaries, energy transit, and military posture.

sections.name: Iran & Iraq
sections.scope: Sanctions enforcement, oil exports, and militia-linked supply risk.

sections.name: Turkey & Anatolia
sections.scope: Inflation credibility, lira policy, and regional economic influence.

regions.name: Sub-Saharan Africa
regions.lede: Commodity and debt dynamics, resource-exporter fiscal dependence, and regional trade blocs. Coverage is Sub-Saharan; North African states are covered under Middle East & North Africa.

sections.name: West Africa
sections.scope: CFA franc arrangements, commodity terms of trade, and fiscal consolidation.

sections.name: East Africa
sections.scope: Inflation, exchange-rate regimes, and regional market integration.

sections.name: Horn of Africa
sections.scope: Shipping-route risk, trade corridor disruption, and drought exposure.

sections.name: Central Africa
sections.scope: Oil and mineral rents, and conflict-affected corridors.

sections.name: Southern Africa
sections.scope: Currency crises, reserve accumulation, and power supply.

also: Mauritania also appears under North Africa, which is where its primary structural coverage sits.

regions.name: Asia
regions.lede: Regional trade architecture, semiconductor and energy supply chains, maritime disputes, and currency policy across the largest growth block in the world.

sections.name: Central Asia
sections.scope: Commodity export revenue, and trade corridors through Russia and China.

sections.name: East Asia
sections.scope: Semiconductor supply chains, export controls, and the yen/yuan regime.

sections.name: South Asia
sections.scope: Trade measures, energy import dependence, and reserve management.

sections.name: Southeast Asia
sections.scope: Electronics assembly, critical-mineral processing, and ASEAN tariff policy.

sections.name: Caucasus
sections.scope: Corridors and pipeline leverage, and the sanctions environment around the South Caucasus routes. The Gulf, Levant and Anatolia sit under Middle East & North Africa, which holds their structural coverage.

regions.name: Oceania & Pacific
regions.lede: Pacific security architecture, supply-chain reconfiguration, and the fiscal and climate exposure of small island states.

sections.name: Australia & New Zealand
sections.scope: Commodity exports, RBA policy, and Pacific financing arrangements.

sections.name: Pacific Islands
sections.scope: Climate finance, shipping-route risk, and resource projects.
